structure.unit: Family Offenses; Crimes Against Children, Etc.

law.catch_line: Penetration of mouth of child with lascivious intent; penalty
law.text: Any person 18 years of age or older who, with lascivious intent, kisses a child under the age of 13 on the mouth while knowingly and intentionally penetrating the mouth of such child with his tongue is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
